# FUZZ-003: Invalid tool arguments are not accepted as a success

| Severity | Applies to | Spec section |
|---|---|---|
| warn | both eras, stdio, http | [2026-07-28/server/tools#security-considerations](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/server/tools#security-considerations) |

Judged from the FUZZ-001 traffic. Servers MUST validate all tool inputs, so arguments that fail the tool's own inputSchema should not come back as a successful result (isError absent or false). A warning rather than an error because lenient servers that coerce, say, "5" to 5 are common and often harmless; the fix is either to validate, or to widen the schema to what the tool really accepts. The failing input is shrunk and saved for mcpprobe replay.

From the command line: `mcpprobe checks explain FUZZ-003`. To leave it out of a run, add `"FUZZ-003"` to `[checks] disable` in [mcpprobe.toml](../configuration.md); to change how much it counts, use `severity_overrides`.
